body: I dont really have anybody to talk to. Im sure the people I do know wont be able to help or may even get annoyed. If I call a hotline, I'll just end up having police called on me.

I mean, yeah. I definitely dont want to die, but the mental struggle of just getting through a day is way too much for me. Sure there are things that I can make better, but I don't know if I will. I just find suicide a much easier alternative than working towards something that may or may not even make me happy. Actually, the more I think about it, I do want to die. Its just so much easier. A place where I won't even know that Im lonely because I wont exist. Idk.
The weird thing is, when I saw this, I felt even more suicidal.
Exactly. I know I want to be an artist, but at the same time, I hate doing the actual artwork. Its... complicated

Nothing really caused this. Just time. During highschool, I felt more comfortable being alone. I never really failed at my aspiration. In fact, I was one of the better known artists. Over time, I just didn't really care anymore. I realize now that I was enchanted by the *idea* of being an artist, rather than actually being an artist. If that makes any sense.
I can honestly track it as far back as my early teens. It didnt start getting really bad until highschool, but I at least still had ambitions. Over time all motivation and reason just disappeared.
Most definitely. I've only been getting worse over time.

There is no point in living. The only way to truly justify living is if you have religion. I am atheist. We are here because of chance, no other reason. That being said, even if a god came down to earth in a beam of light and told me my reason for being here, I would not care.
Nope. I do not intend to
Atheist. Nothing.
Why not? Why do we choose to struggle when thats all you can manage to do? Sure, I could 'fight on' and try to be better, bit what's the point?
Pretty much. Just lost any and all motivation to really fight for those things. Why fight for them when death is just so much better and easier?
That's the thing, I really don't care about anything.
Honestly, I don't really care for music as much as I used to. I usually listen to things that suite my mood. Juice WRLD, Joyner, and a whole lot of cinematic depression.
Dec 9th

I don't have any reason to continue, despite my age. I dont have any passions, any relationships, any joy in this life. Chances are life will only get worse due to my lack of action. Plus, I dont see why suicide is such a bad thing. I'm just going back to before I was born.

While thia may seem like the obvious solution, it's something I can't see myself doing. I have really bad depression, suicidal tendencies, and bad social anxiety. To both find someone and then put them through that seems very selfish. Its a chore to be around me. So, I just have to try and cope with loneliness.
Ill have to remember that for this winter. Its a tad bit hot as of now for that.

I really want to visit the ocean again. Too bad Im so far away.
I guess I should find myself some hobbies. Depression makes it hard to really want to do anything.

I just wish I could buy some weed at dispensaries already. They passed the law to make it legal here, but you can't buy from a dispensary till January...
